content: Task ledger update: Hermes Discord gateway receipt recording action implemented. Added /gateway action:record_receipt to the Annunimas Discord bot. It requires a matching canonical task id and summary, writes annunimas.hermes_agent_gateway_background_result.v1 to data/hermes/hermes_agent_gateway_receipts.jsonl, and records a HERMES subagent completion packet/comms event without approving or closing the task. Updated the gateway runbook and canonical plan with Discord usage. Verification: cargo fmt --check -p annunimas-hermes; cargo test -p annunimas-hermes serenity_bot -- --nocapture; git diff --check on touched files; cargo run -p annunimas-cli -- utility hermes-agent-gateway-activation-check.
